title: [29.X]-Inconsistent Validation of Non-Deductible VAT % for Purchase Lines Sharing the Same VAT Identifier
summary: The non-deductible VAT validation for purchase lines sharing the same VAT identifier has been corrected to ensure consistent behavior across different localization scenarios.
key_points: Fixed validation logic for non-deductible VAT percentages when multiple purchase lines use the same VAT identifier
Added and updated test cases across W1, AU, CZ, IT, and RU localizations to cover the correction
Removed unnecessary code from the base implementation
Enhanced test coverage to verify consistent VAT validation behavior
